title: The Inventory list's available quantity still ignores a negative bin
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-PICK-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A} at a cost of $10.00, with 5 in {Bin-A} and -2 in {Bin-B}.
  • Line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL IV NET AVAILABLE") of work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) took 2 of {Part-A} from {Bin-B} while {Bin-B} held 0, which put {Bin-B} at -2.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A}.
  2. Read the Total Qty cell.
  3. Open Reports → Inventory Value with the Location filter on {Location-A} only and the as-of date on today.
  4. Search the part number of {Part-A} and read its Qty.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Total Qty keeps the shop-floor figure: "5 Available", the positive bin only; the -2 bin is not taken off what can be picked.
  • Step 4: The Inventory Value report, by contrast, shows Qty 3.00 (5 + (-2)): only the report changed to the net figure.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; Ready to Fix, updated 9 Oct 2026; ships with this epic per Chris Ward's comments of 24 Sep and 7 Oct 2026), description, reproduction table and acceptance criteria, read 13 Oct 2026 and unchanged on 14 Oct 2026; PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), §2 Accounting, read 14 Oct 2026; QA lead's set-up answers of 9 Oct 2026 (situation 1: a bin below zero). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • SV-10380 acceptance criteria: “The parts list's available-to-pick quantity and supply filters retain their existing behavior.”
  • SV-10380 expected behavior: “Keep the shop-floor availability calculation unchanged. Availability for picking and financial valuation serve different purposes and must not share a positive-only rule merely for consistency.”
  • SV-10380 summary: “The Inventory Value report uses positive-bin availability rather than net recorded stock to calculate inventory value.”
